description: WP-M4c Codex: Space Marines (11e) COMBAT EMBARKATION (Repulsor) through the new enemy_declares_charge window. Fixture sm11e_m4c_enemy_charge (P2 Orks' Charge phase): an Intercessor Squad stands wholly within 3" of a Repulsor; the Boyz are 7" away. The Boyz declare a charge against the Intercessors; the Space Marine player's window opens with the free Combat Embarkation card; a real click + the Intercessors in the picker embarks them within the Repulsor (off the battlefield, in its transport list). The Boyz can no longer select them as a charge target. Also covers the transport capacity fix: the Intercessors can embark at all (the army text says SPACE MARINES INFANTRY).

steps.comment: a charge-phase-start window (not under test), if any
the transport capacity keywords read ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY: the Intercessors can embark

a datasheet ability card: no CP cost
off the battlefield, in the Repulsor's transport list
the Boyz can no longer select the Intercessors as a charge target
